ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is an animal life cycle diagram enclosed in a circle. The letter F is located at the top of the figure, with the largest red animal with the most complete body structure drawn beside it; there are also smaller young individuals or developmental stages around it, connected by arrows into a cycle. Reasoning: In a life cycle diagram, the largest and fully developed individual usually represents the adult stage. Therefore, F shows an animal that is already fully mature.
